comb_level_accounting.note: render_noise centres mic_line_gain_db over mics (per rotor) and mic_gains_db over mics before use, so their ABSOLUTE values are discarded by the renderer; the only absolute comb scale a render has is profile_db

frozen_from.rule: log-mean of the rates and scales, dB-mean of the per-order profile over the fits that reach each order

tracked.statistic: mean over line bins / median over local floor bins, median over frames

legacy.label: legacy stage-2 baseline, identity-matched on this recording

v2_comb_bench_ratio.hypothesis: H3, comb side: restore the ratio the frozen comb was fitted under
v2_comb_bench_ratio.label: v2 with the comb re-levelled so its k=2 comb-to-floor equals the one the BENCH fits identified it at

v2_comb_level_matched.hypothesis: H3, comb side: the comb carries the real clip's own broadband level
v2_comb_level_matched.label: v2 with the comb re-levelled so the FULL render's band level matches the real window's

v2_comb_real_ratio.hypothesis: the literal (e): match real's OWN measured k=2 comb-to-floor
v2_comb_real_ratio.label: v2 with the comb re-levelled so its k=2 line prominence matches the real clip's

v2_floor_matched.hypothesis: H3, floor side: is the floor level itself wrong?
v2_floor_matched.label: v2 with the floor re-levelled onto THIS window's real band level

v2_nocomb.hypothesis: control: what the render scores with NO comb at all
v2_nocomb.label: v2 with the comb muted (floor only)

v2_nofloor.hypothesis: control: is the frozen comb trackable on its own?
v2_nofloor.label: v2 with the floor muted (the frozen bench comb alone)

v2_prior_exps.hypothesis: H1: the R1 regime patch — are the exponents the defect here too?
v2_prior_exps.label: v2 with both speed exponents at their prior means (amp_exp = floor_exp = 2, static_rel at its own prior mean)

H1_speed_law.claim: the bench comb was fitted at ~68 rev/s and the DREGON cruise carriers differ; the speed law / k_max geometry must be checked at the cruise carriers

H2_mic_gain_units.claim: a units / per-rotor level mismatch in mic_line_gain_db or mic_gains_db
H2_mic_gain_units.renderer_note: render_noise centres mic_line_gain_db over mics (per rotor) and mic_gains_db over mics before use, so their ABSOLUTE values are discarded by the renderer; the only absolute comb scale a render has is profile_db

H3_floor_buries_comb.claim: the floor-only flight fit's floor buries the frozen bench comb

H4_wrong_speed.claim: the render encodes a different speed than the label
H4_wrong_speed.scored_fraction_note: every frozen DREGON support is one 4 s cruise window; scored_seconds is reported per support
